narr: Widespread, mostly sub-severe convection, developed on the periphery of a low-pressure center as it traversed across portions of the Ozarks. Localized heavy rainfall across eastern Oklahoma lead to an instance of flash flooding near Seminole, OK.
ev: Numerous streets flooded due to heavy rainfall.
